summary: End-to-end validation of AI Tool Emporium MVP (backend + frontend). 30/30 pytest cases pass and all critical UI flows work: catalog + filters + search + sort, JWT + admin auth, live AI tool demo (Emergent LLM + Claude), ARIA streaming assistant, Stripe checkout (real hosted URL returned), library empty-state, admin dashboard with recharts + orders table, non-admin gating.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 563 lines — still one file. Consider splitting into routers (auth, catalog, payments, admin, ai) if it grows beyond ~700 lines.

GET /api/admin/orders returns raw payment_transactions docs; datetime fields serialize via FastAPI default. Fine today but if you add mongo _id in the future, exclude it (already excluded via projection).
payment_status endpoint returns 200 even when payment_transactions record contains 'unpaid' string from Stripe; the assertion in tests accepts both 'pending' and 'unpaid'.
AriaAssistant.jsx does not check resp.ok before reading resp.body — if the endpoint 500s, the UI silently sets an empty assistant message. Consider surfacing an error toast.

CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True. Works, but browsers still reject credentials with wildcard origin; the regex sidesteps this. Consider whitelisting explicit FRONTEND_URL for production hardening.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@aitoolemporium.com / Emporium@2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Regular users created dynamically via /register.
seed_data_creation: None. Test data created and cleaned via API (TEST_ prefixed emails). Stripe checkout sessions created against live Stripe test mode (test key sk_test_...).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Runs in ~17s with pytest-xdist. Every /api endpoint from the review request is exercised (catalog, auth, ai demo, aria stream, payments checkout+status, library, admin stats+orders). Frontend flows verified: home, marketplace filters/search/sort, add-to-cart, tool detail demo terminal, ARIA panel streaming, register→library, admin login→Command Center dashboard with charts, non-admin gating via ProtectedRoute. Stripe checkout redirect returns a real checkout.stripe.com URL with cs_test_ session id; the actual card entry step was intentionally skipped per instructions.
verified_flows: GET /api/tools returns exactly 18 tools; category=marketing → 4 tools; search=copy → filtered results; sort=price_asc/desc/rating all ordered correctly.
GET /api/categories returns 12 categories with counts summing to 18.
GET /api/tools/{slug} returns tool without demo_system; unknown slug → 404.
POST /api/auth/register sets session_token cookie and returns user; duplicate email → 400.
POST /api/auth/login with admin creds returns role=admin; wrong password → 401.
GET /api/auth/me works with cookie; POST /api/auth/logout removes session (next /me returns 401).
POST /api/tools/brandforge/demo generates 1100+ char AI output; empty input → 400; unknown slug → 404.
POST /api/assistant/chat streams text/plain response recommending tools.
POST /api/payments/checkout returns checkout_url starting with https://checkout.stripe.com and cs_test_ session_id; inserts payment_transactions with status=initiated/pending.
GET /api/admin/stats and /api/admin/orders → 401 unauth / 403 for user / 200 for admin with revenue_series, top_tools, aov, totals.
Frontend: register form → auto-login → /library; admin login shows 'Command' nav → /admin renders StatCards + AreaChart + orders table with pending rows; non-admin visiting /admin is redirected away.
Frontend: ToolCard add-to-cart → cart-count updates; /cart → checkout-btn → window.location redirects to real Stripe hosted URL.
